action.details: Invokes Scrivener's published “Scrivener/Scrivener: Append to Text” macOS Service with the selection.
action.exampleInput: An additional paragraph for the current document.
action.exampleOutput: Scrivener appends the paragraph to the current document text.

integration.name: Scrivener
integration.summary: Create clippings or append selected text to a Scrivener project.

action.name: Scrivener — Append to Text
action.privacySummary: ActionClip passes the selected text locally to Scrivener through its macOS Service. Scrivener controls any later sync.
action.requirements: Scrivener 2 or 3 must be installed, a project must be open, and its Append to Text Service must be enabled.
action.summary: Append the selection to the current Scrivener document text.
